calculation.description: Ranks assets positively when they have large 120-day drawdowns and an inefficient/choppy 60-day path, scaled by recent annualized volatility. Lower-volatility recoveries receive greater rank for comparable drawdown and path inefficiency. Signal is lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead.
